title: Pitanja i odgovori, izmene Dogovora, deljenje lokacije i grupni Dogovor
method: Read-only audit of every file in scope, the routes that open them (src/app/dogovor/[id].tsx rows at L388-395 and L405-411, GroupConversationEntry, prilike/[id], potrebe/[id]/pregled, obavestenja) and the suites that pin them (TaskQaScreen.test, v5-agreement-actions-screen, v5-agreement-current-location-screen, v5-group-conversation-screen, agreement-private-location, agreement-photo-composer, agreement-chat-ui, one-token-source, outputs/audit-20260924/client-terminal-photos.repro).

screens.purpose: Anonymous public questions about one task: a worker asks, the task owner answers, skips or reports; answered questions are the public thread. Every write goes through the durable Q&A intent journal (saved before any I/O), the AI text classification and the exact-receipt recovery.
problems: TaskQaScreen.tsx:198-226 — the whole screen is SettingsScreen/SettingsIntro/SettingsPanel: every question is a settings panel (a card), the composer is another panel, so a public thread reads as a settings page.

TaskQaScreen.tsx:201 — the first read is a bare ActivityIndicator over an empty page; a failed read is only a text line (L202) with no way forward except the big refresh button at the very end (L225).

TaskQaScreen.tsx:211-220 — the ask/answer composer is a card in the middle of the scroll, above the thread, with a 120 px multi-line box (L230); the brief asks for the same floating pill as Poruke and the AI chat, docked above the keyboard.

TaskQaScreen.tsx:187 — every question carries the label 'Anonimno pitanje' (repeated noise; anonymity is said once in the intro); an old revision shows the raw revision number ('Ranija verzija zadatka · 3').
TaskQaScreen.tsx:193 — 'Preskoči pitanje' and 'Prijavi pitanje' fire a durable write on one tap, with no confirmation; they are the only destructive actions of the screen.
TaskQaScreen.tsx:222 — the empty thread is a card with one muted sentence; no empty-state look.
TaskQaScreen.tsx:225 — 'Osveži pitanja i ishod radnje' is a full-width secondary button at the end of a possibly long list.
TaskQaScreen.tsx:230 — hand-written padding 14 and minHeight 120.
composition: SPLIT: TaskQaScreen keeps every hook, ref, guard, journal and service call exactly as today and renders a NEW pure TaskQaPresentation (same file) from props; the gallery draws TaskQaPresentation with fixtures.

CHROME: KeyboardAvoidingView > SafeAreaView(top,bottom) white > ScreenChrome detail (arrow 'Nazad', title = task title or 'Pitanja o zadatku' until it is known, subtitle 'Pitanja o zadatku' when the task title is shown); right slot = ChromeIconButton ArrowClockwise 'Osveži pitanja i ishod radnje' (disabled while busy).

BODY (ScrollView): the intro sentence kept word for word as one muted line: 'Pitanja su anonimna. Javno se prikazuju samo pitanja na koja je odgovoreno. Ne unosiš kontakt, preciznu adresu ni podatke za pristup.'

Then the notices, in this order and only when present: message (role alert, danger ink), receipt (polite), the material-answer action, the recovery inset (wash, control radius: 'Provera prethodne radnje', the kept sentences, the re-entry field, 'Ponovi isti zahtev' green, 'Odustani od ovog slanja' quiet), the cannot-ask inset (kept three sentences).

OWNER: section heading 'Čekaju odgovor' with a quiet count; each pending question is a bare item (no card): the question bodyStrong, one row of actions: 'Odgovori' (secondary), 'Preskoči pitanje' and 'Prijavi pitanje' (quiet) — skip and report ask first through ConfirmSheet ('Preskočiti pitanje?' / 'Pitanje se sklanja iz neodgovorenih i ne objavljuje se.' / 'Preskoči'; 'Prijaviti pitanje?' / 'Pitanje ide na proveru i sklanja se iz neodgovorenih.' / 'Prijavi', tone danger).

THREAD: heading 'Pitanja i odgovori'; each answered question is a bare item separated by a hairline: question bodyStrong, then the answer in body ink behind a 3 px green left rule ('Odgovor' / 'Odgovor · izmenjen' as a muted label), then (owner) 'Izmeni odgovor' secondary. Skipped/reported (owner) keep their muted status word. Older versions (owner): heading 'Prethodne verzije' + kept sentence 'Ovi odgovori ne opisuju aktuelne uslove zadatka.'; each item labelled 'Ranija verzija zadatka' (no raw revision number).

COMPOSER: a NEW shared PillComposer (src/ui/system/PillComposer.tsx, the Poruke pill: wash capsule, sheet radius, text + 40 px send circle in a 48 px target, green when it can send, grey well when not) docked under the scroll, above the keyboard. Asking: placeholder 'Napiši pitanje…', label 'Tekst pitanja', send 'Pošalji pitanje'. Answering: a context line above the pill ('Odgovor na: <pitanje>' + X 'Zatvori odgovor'), the kept sentence 'Odgovor razjašnjava postojeće uslove. Za promenu uslova vrati se na zadatak i izmeni ga kroz pregled i objavu.', label 'Tekst odgovora', send 'Objavi odgovor'. The empty-field reason ('Upiši pitanje pre slanja.' / 'Upiši odgovor pre objave.') is the send's spoken hint; a visible muted line says the reason when it is not the empty field (text longer than the limit: '<n> / <max> znakova — skrati tekst.'; revision changed: the kept alert).

Copy that changes: 'Objavljena pitanja i odgovori' → 'Pitanja i odgovori'; 'Anonimno pitanje' label dropped; 'Ranija verzija zadatka · N' → 'Ranija verzija zadatka'; empty thread 'Još nema objavljenih odgovora' + 'Odgovoreno pitanje se ovde prikazuje javno.'.
states: loading (first read, no context yet): StateView loading 'Učitavamo pitanja…' (3 rows); later reads keep the thread and disable the refresh and actions (busy).
error (context or feed failed, no context): StateView error 'Pitanja nisu učitana' + the service message as body + green 'Pokušaj ponovo' (run(restore)).
offline: the same error path (the service does not tell offline apart; nothing invented).
not signed in / bad link: StateView error with the kept sentence 'Ponovo otvori zadatak sa prijavljenog naloga.' and no retry.
empty thread: StateView empty (art chat) 'Još nema objavljenih odgovora'.
disabled-with-reason: cannot ask (kept three sentences in an inset, no composer); send grey with spoken reason; over the limit visible line; revision changed alert.
sending: send circle shows a spinner and is busy; field read-only.
success: the kept receipt sentences (polite live region).
large text / 320 dp: every row wraps; the pill grows to 140 px then scrolls; actions wrap in a row with gap.
keepUntouched: Everything above the render in TaskQaScreen.tsx (L20-185): live(), readFeed(), finish(), consumeAi(), readIntent(), restore(), run(), the focus/AppState effect, send(), submit() guards (context, intent, status, revision, max chars), retry() exact-text hash check, cancel(), choose(), renderGeneration fence, the rejected set, all receipt/message strings.
pitanja-zadatka.tsx route: key, needId validation, onBack fallbacks.
testsToUpdate: src/ui/qa/__tests__/TaskQaScreen.test.tsx: the SettingsPresentation mock goes; buttons are found by label on V2Action / ChromeIconButton / PillComposer send (accessibilityLabel) instead of type 'SettingsAction'; 'a grey send button says why' asserts the reason as the send's hint; add: skip/report ask through ConfirmSheet before any dispositionQuestion call, and the presentation renders the thread without reading anything.

screens.purpose: Change the terms of a Dogovor (propose, answer the other side's proposal, withdraw your own) or cancel it with a reason; every write goes through AgreementActionsController with the durable journal, the explicit review and the unknown-outcome recovery with exact re-entry.
problems: AgreementActionsScreen.tsx:133 — one DetailTopBar for all phases: the form and the review are steps of a serious flow but look like the same page, and leaving a half-filled form is only a quiet button at the bottom (L155, L161).
AgreementActionsScreen.tsx:139 and 189 — the current terms are a washed inset, and the form/review/actions are a card (L190) that holds that inset: a box in a box.
AgreementActionsScreen.tsx:33-34 — 'Cena: 3.500 RSD' / 'Obim: …' as prefixed sentences; a proposal repeats the full terms without saying WHAT changes.
AgreementActionsScreen.tsx:136 — loading is a text line; an error (L137) is a text line in danger over nothing; the ERROR phase button is a plain secondary.
AgreementActionsScreen.tsx:160 — the decisive action is a plain white secondary; 'Otkaži Dogovor' does not look destructive; no primary anywhere (no green).
AgreementActionsScreen.tsx:167 — CONFIRMED/REJECTED show the controller message as a heading (L138) and a white button; no success look.
AgreementActionsScreen.tsx:178-180 — 'Predloži izmenu uslova', 'Otkazivanje Dogovora' and 'Osveži uslove Dogovora' are stacked with equal weight; the refresh is a full row.
AgreementActionsScreen.tsx:145 — the price field has no currency beside the amount; the label carries it ('Predložena cena u RSD').
AgreementActionsScreen.tsx:186 — hand-written padding 20/32 and gap 16.
composition: SPLIT: AgreementActionsScreen keeps the controller, refs, focus/AppState effect, openForm/edit/prepare/prepareForm/send/run exactly; it renders a NEW pure AgreementActionsPresentation (new file src/ui/agreements/AgreementActionsPresentation.tsx) from a view model and callbacks.

HUB (phase READY, no form, no review) — ScreenChrome detail 'Izmene i otkazivanje', right: ArrowClockwise 'Osveži uslove Dogovora'. Body: heading 'Važeći uslovi' then the terms as bare fact rows (FactArt money / calendar / document): amount in money type with its currency, schedule by needScheduleText in Serbian time or 'Termin nije potvrđen', scope or 'Nije dodat opis'.

Proposals: each as a section under a hairline: heading ('Predlog druge strane' / 'Tvoj predlog čeka odgovor'), the proposed terms as the same fact rows where a CHANGED value is bold with a muted 'umesto <staro>' line, the reason as a quoted muted line; other side's: green 'Pregledaj prihvatanje izmene' (disabled with reason 'Uslovi predloga nisu dostupni za pregled.' when terms are unavailable) + quiet 'Pregledaj odbijanje predloga'; own: quiet 'Pregledaj povlačenje predloga'.
Then 'Predloži izmenu uslova' (secondary; green only when no proposal waits for me, so one green per screen) and, set apart at the end, 'Otkazivanje Dogovora' (destructive text).

FORM (step 1) — ScreenChrome flow: X 'Odustani od unosa', title 'Predlog izmene' / 'Otkazivanje Dogovora' / 'Ponovni unos prvobitnog zahteva', step 'Korak 1 od 2'. Fields: price with a trailing 'RSD' unit (label 'Predložena cena u RSD' kept for the reader), scope (multi-line), the kept line 'Vreme unosiš po vremenu u Srbiji.', start date/time and end date/time CivilFields, reason ('Razlog predloga — opciono' / 'Razlog otkazivanja Dogovora'). Re-entry keeps its kept sentence. Validation errors under the field group as role alert. One green 'Pregledaj predlog' / 'Pregledaj otkazivanje'.

REVIEW (step 2) — flow chrome: X 'Odustani od radnje', title per command ('Pregled predloga', 'Otkazivanje Dogovora', 'Prihvatanje izmene', 'Odbijanje predloga', 'Povlačenje predloga'), step 'Korak 2 od 2' for PROPOSE/CANCEL. CANCEL keeps its three binding sentences word for word ('Dogovor se završava otkazivanjem. Deljeni kontakt i precizna lokacija se opozivaju. Radnja sama ne određuje krivicu ili dug.') and shows the reason as 'Razlog: …'. Others show the proposed terms (changes marked) and keep their consequence sentence word for word. The decisive button: green for propose/accept, danger fill for 'Otkaži Dogovor', 'Odbij predlog' and 'Povuci predlog'; loading while SENDING.

UNKNOWN — detail chrome; a warn inset with the controller message, green 'Proveri ishod radnje', then 'Unesi prvobitni zahtev' or 'Ponovi istu radnju' (secondary, disabled with reason 'Prvo proveri ishod radnje.' when retry is not allowed).
CONFIRMED / REJECTED — SuccessMark (check for confirmed, info tone for rejected) + the controller message as the title + green 'Prikaži aktuelni Dogovor'.
states: loading: StateView loading 'Učitavamo važeće uslove…' (2 rows).
error (no snapshot): StateView error 'Dogovor nije učitan' + message + green 'Ponovo učitaj Dogovor'; with a snapshot the error is an alert line above the hub.
offline: same error path.
disabled-with-reason: acceptance without reviewable terms; retry before the outcome is known.
sending: the decisive button spins, the X is disabled.
success: SuccessMark + message; rejected (settled otherwise) with the kept message.
large text / 320 dp: fact rows wrap; CivilFields full width; buttons full width.
keepUntouched: AgreementActionsController, agreementActionsModel (journalFor, normalizeAgreementCommand, validProposal), the payload-hash check, the price regex /^[1-9][0-9]*$/ and safe-integer check, the untouched-endpoint precision rule, the reviewBase/submitting fences, every controller message and the three binding cancellation sentences, the consequence sentences of the review, the back fallback to /dogovor/[id].
testsToUpdate: v5-agreement-actions-screen.test.tsx: 'Pregledaj radnju' becomes 'Pregledaj predlog' / 'Pregledaj otkazivanje'; the flow X carries 'Odustani od radnje' (found by label on ChromeIconButton); everything else unchanged. Add: the hub offers one green action at most; a changed value shows 'umesto'.

screens.purpose: The worker shares ONE current point of the phone with the other side of an active physical Dogovor; the requester can ask for it. Never live tracking; the last shared point is shown still, with when it was taken and sent.
problems: AgreementLocationScreen.tsx:40-49 — a column of sentences and cards (group = card, L69): the last point, the share explanation and the unknown state are each a card, the loading/sending states are text lines.
AgreementLocationScreen.tsx:42 — 'Zabeležena … · poslata …' is one dense line; 'Preciznost oko N m.' a separate line; nothing says WHO sees the point.
AgreementLocationScreen.tsx:46-47 — the share action is a plain white button inside a card of explanation; 'Zatraži trenutnu lokaciju' likewise; no primary.
AgreementLocationScreen.tsx:48 — the closed context is one muted sentence with no look.
AgreementLocationScreen.tsx:43-44 — two sentences say the same thing (earlier point / does not confirm now).
AgreementLocationScreen.tsx:67 — hand-written padding 20/40, gap 16.
composition: SPLIT: the screen keeps the controller and fences; renders a NEW pure AgreementLocationPresentation (new file src/ui/agreements/AgreementLocationPresentation.tsx).
CHROME: detail 'Trenutna lokacija', right ArrowClockwise 'Osveži prikaz' (READY or ERROR).

BODY: the kept consent sentence 'Jedna tačka, podeljena dobrovoljno u ovom Dogovoru. Prikaz se ne pomera i ne prati putovanje.' as the lead; then three bare fact rows that say what, with whom and how long, each only from what the app really does: pin 'Jedna tačka, ne praćenje' / 'Telefon uzima lokaciju samo kada pritisneš dugme.'; users 'Vidi je samo druga strana ovog Dogovora'; clock 'Prikazuje se poslednja podeljena tačka' — the read returns exactly one point (context.point); no expiry is claimed.

LAST POINT: heading 'Poslednja podeljena tačka', the static disabled map, fact lines 'Zabeležena: <vreme>' and 'Poslata: <vreme>', 'Preciznost oko N m', and the kept warning 'Ovo je ranije zabeležena tačka. Ne potvrđuje sadašnji položaj.' (warn ink).
REQUESTED: 'Lokacija je zatražena: <vreme>. Deljenje je opciono.' (kept) as an orange-dot notice (the one orange of the screen).

ACTION (one primary): worker green 'Podeli jednu trenutnu lokaciju' with the kept sentence above it; requester green 'Zatraži trenutnu lokaciju'. CAPTURING: the button area becomes a row with spinner 'Uzimam jednu novu lokaciju telefona…' and quiet 'Prekini deljenje'. SENDING: 'Čekamo potvrdu…' spinner.
UNKNOWN: warn inset with the message, green 'Proveri prvobitni zahtev', quiet 'Zaustavi zahtev ako još nije poslat', kept sentence.
CONFIRMED: SuccessMark + controller message + green 'Prikaži stanje lokacije'.
CLOSED (no share, no request): StateView empty art lock with the kept sentence 'Deljenje je dostupno samo učesnicima aktivnog fizičkog Dogovora kada važe dozvole za kontakt.'
PERMISSION DENIED: PermissionRecovery with the controller message (unchanged).
states: loading: StateView loading 'Proveravamo Dogovor…'.
error: StateView error with the message and green 'Pokušaj ponovo' (refresh).
offline: same error path.
capturing / sending / unknown / confirmed / closed / permission denied as above.
large text / 320 dp: fact rows wrap; map full width.
keepUntouched: AgreementLocationController (capture abort on blur/background/account, journal without coordinates, recover, cancelUnknown), the fences in the screen, every controller message, the static disabled ResolvedPinMap with its scopeKey, the back fallback.
testsToUpdate: v5-agreement-current-location-screen.test.tsx: unchanged labels; 'Zabeležena: ' stays; 'poslata: ' becomes 'Poslata: ' (capital, its own line) — update the assertion. Add: the what/who facts are drawn and no word implies live tracking ('uživo', 'prati').

problems: AgreementPrivateLocation.tsx:97 — a 'Privatna lokacija' title inside a section already titled 'Lokacija i pristup': a duplicated title.
AgreementPrivateLocation.tsx:98-100 — the state is one muted meta line; how long the grant lasts (grant.expiresAt) is read but never said.
AgreementPrivateLocation.tsx:108-109 — a quiet refresh plus an explanation sentence under every state.
AgreementPrivateLocation.tsx:125-131 — each point is a stack with coordinates, then a quiet button per point; points have no FactArt and no separation.
composition: No title (the section carries it). A status row: FactArt lock/eye + one line of state (the kept four sentences) + a muted 'Važi do <vreme>' when the grant has an expiry, 'Važi dok je ne opozoveš ili dok se Dogovor ne završi.' when it has none.
Requester: 'Podeli lokaciju' secondary / 'Opozovi deljenje lokacije' destructive (loading while busy). Worker: 'Prikaži privatnu lokaciju' secondary.

Revealed: address and access notes, then each point as a bare row under a hairline (bodyStrong slot label, address, access notes, selectable coordinates, quiet 'Prikaži na mapi: …' when there are several), then the static map.
Quiet 'Osveži dozvolu za lokaciju' with the kept sentence under it.

granted/not granted per side

ownerDecisions: Group messages have no delivery/read state per message (the read does not carry it) — nothing is drawn; confirm this is acceptable for the group thread.

Q&A skip/report now ask through ConfirmSheet with two new sentences ('Pitanje se sklanja iz neodgovorenih i ne objavljuje se.' / 'Pitanje ide na proveru i sklanja se iz neodgovorenih.') — wording open to the owner.

Location sharing has no duration: the app shares one point on press and the last point stays visible to the other side; whether an old point should expire from view is a privacy decision for the owner (server change).
risks: Suites mock react-native with a Proxy and SettingsPresentation by name; moving the Q&A screen off SettingsPresentation changes its harness (done inside the unit's own test).
ScreenChrome/ConfirmSheet import phosphor, the brand lockup and the gorhom sheet; all have Jest mocks already used by other screen suites.
No new supabaseClient import may enter a screen module (route-harness caveat); the new presentation files import only UI.
PillComposer is used inside FlatList footers/KeyboardAvoidingView; keep the TextInput count at one per screen (suites find it by type).
